{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode = Basketball |year = 2019–20 |team = Central Michigan Chippewas |image = Central Michigan Chippewas logo.svg |image_size = 150 |conference = Mid-American Conference |division = West Division |short_conf = MAC |record = 14–18 |conf_record = 7–11 |head_coach = [[Keno Davis]] |hc_year = 8th |asst_coach1 = Chris Davis |asst_coach2 = Chris Tifft |asst_coach3 = DJ Mocini |stadium = [[McGuirk Arena]] |champion = |bowl = |bowl_result = = }} {{2019–20 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team''' represented [[Central Michigan University]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Chippewas, led by eighth-year head coach [[Keno Davis]], played their home games at [[McGuirk Arena]] as members of the West Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 14–18, 7–11 in MAC play to finish in fourth place in the West Division. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to [[2019–20 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|Ohio]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team|Chippewas]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 23–12, 10–8 in MAC play to finish in second place in the West Division. They defeated [[2018–19 Western Michigan Broncos men's basketball team|Western Michigan]] in the first round of the [[2019 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] and [[2018–19 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to 18th ranked [[2018–19 Buffalo Bulls men's basketball team|Buffalo]]. They were invited to the [[2019 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where were defeated by [[2018–19 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
